pandas.DataFrame.to_parquet

pandas 3.1.1 · DataFrame · method

Write a DataFrame in the Parquet columnar format. Set compression or partition_cols where needed.

Call syntax

DataFrame.to_parquet(…) Full signature
DataFrame.to_parquet(
    path=None,
    *,
    engine=…,
    compression='snappy',
    index=None,
    partition_cols=None,
    storage_options=None,
    filesystem=None,
    **kwargs,
)
